verdict.rationale: An uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions for a hosted SaaS planning tool like GitHub Projects, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a published uptime SLA, a status page, or incident reporting; the docs cover only views, fields, workflows, the API, MCP and the CLI.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
